definitions.text: An armadillo (Tatusia novemcincta) which is found from Texas to Paraguay; -- called also tatouhou.

A small roundish stone or bowlder; especially, a stone worn and rounded by the action of water; a pebblestone. "The pebbles on the hungry beach." Shak. As children gathering pebbles on the shore. Milton.
Transparent and colorless rock crystal; as, Brazilian pebble; -- so called by opticians. Pebble powder, slow-burning gunpowder, in large cubical grains. obtained from cavities in amygdaloid.
To grain (leather) so as to produce a surface covered with small rounded prominences.
A pebble; also, pebbles collectively. "Chains of pebblestone." Marlowe.
Full of pebbles; pebbled. "A hard, pebbly bottom." Johnson.
An epidemic disease of the silkworm, characterized by the presence of minute vibratory corpuscles in the blood.
